description: An oil-painting style scene of a brown-and-white cow with a garland of yellow daisies around its neck, its head filling the centre-right. Behind it and to the left are glass milk bottles on a wooden counter, and at the bottom are more bottles, some filled with milk. The background shows a dusky fairground at night with striped tents, string lights, and silhouetted people in period-looking clothing. No visible text, frame or wounds.
